name: University of Tennessee at Chattanooga
oos_note: Public university. Out-of-state undergraduate tuition & fees derived from official UTC Bursar FY2026-27 Out-of-State Fee Schedule (fy2026-27-fee-schedule-bursar-website-final-part-2.pdf). Full-time (12+ hrs) per-semester total = $9,819 (maintenance $4,452 + out-of-state tuition surcharge $4,277 + mandatory fees $1,090). Annual = $9,819 x 2 = $19,638. Tuition & fees only, excludes housing/meals.
